app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureScore.ts:183 The stored cue address is the scene list alone with no offset, so it re-derives on a retime but cannot resolve inside a scene.

pairs.registryProposal: drift-correction states status-follows-measurement only in the direction of a drifting clip zeroed back to placed; it could also state the reverse, that a placed clip moved off its mark past the threshold must read as drifting, since an implementation can satisfy the written example and still report a large offset as ok.
